title: Valuation-stratum size as totient times orbit length
statement: Let p be prime and a,j natural numbers with 1 ≤ j < a. The number of residues z modulo p^a whose canonical representatives are divisible by p^j but not by p^(j+1) equals φ(p^min(j,a−j)) · p^(a−2j), with natural subtraction truncated at zero and φ Euler’s totient.
lean_statement: ∀ (p a j : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → 1 ≤ j → j < a → Nat.card {z : ZMod (p ^ a) // p ^ j ∣ z.val ∧ ¬ p ^ (j + 1) ∣ z.val} = Nat.totient (p ^ min j (a - j)) * p ^ (a - 2 * j)
